papers.title: Vasoactive Intestinal Polypeptide-Expressing Interneurons in the Hippocampus Support Goal-Oriented Spatial Learning.
Brainstem nucleus incertus controls contextual memory formation.
Hippocampal Network Reorganization Underlies the Formation of a Temporal Association Memory.

pipeline_steps.technique: Image preprocessing: motion correction (HMM for dual-plane, Suite2p non-rigid registration for single-plane), ROI detection and fluorescence/neuropil-corrected extraction, manual curation

parameters.dual_plane_motion_correction: modified 2D hidden Markov model, re-initialized per plane to account for piezo settling time
parameters.residual_motion_handling: trials with inadequately corrected motion discarded after visual assessment
parameters.roi_curation: manual post-hoc curation via Suite2p GUI to exclude non-somatic components

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected, curated per-ROI fluorescence traces

pipeline_steps.technique: Cross-session ROI registration via affine transformation of fields of view and Hungarian-algorithm optimal matching of ROI pairs by Jaccard spatial overlap, with manual curation of unmatched ROIs

parameters.reference_session_choice: session with the largest number of detected neurons
parameters.auto_new_roi_threshold: current-ROI centroid > 50 pixels from any unpaired reference ROI

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: per-session ROI masks and fluorescence traces
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: cross-session-registered common ROI pool with per-session identity

pipeline_steps.technique: Event detection via OASIS non-negative deconvolution, amplitude thresholding, and per-frame discretization of activity

parameters.amplitude_threshold: events below 4 median absolute deviations of the raw trace discarded
parameters.discretization_rationale: prevents cross-session variation in imaging parameters from biasing calcium-event scale

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: discretized per-frame putative-event traces

pipeline_steps.technique: General population decoding framework using linear-kernel support vector machines with repeated cross-validation and shuffled-label null distributions

parameters.null_model: classifier retrained on shuffled surrogate data

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: cross-validated decoding accuracy and null-distribution comparison

pipeline_steps.technique: Decoding of elapsed trial time from population activity via a one-vs-one ensemble of pairwise linear time-bin classifiers, at multiple time resolutions

parameters.fine_resolution: 2.5 s bins (14 population vectors/trial), 91 pairwise classifiers
parameters.null_model: 1000 surrogate datasets with per-trial randomized time-bin order
parameters.grouping: computed separately for CS+ and CS-, and for Pre- vs. Post-Learning blocks

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: time-decoding accuracy matrices and null comparison

pipeline_steps.technique: Decoding of CS stimulus identity from instantaneous and average population firing rates, including cross-time-period generalization analysis

parameters.average_rate_windows: Pre-CS (-10 to 0 s), CS (0-20 s), Trace (20-35 s), US (35-40 s), Post-US (40-170 s), and combined CS+Trace (0-35 s)
parameters.null_model: 1000 surrogate datasets with shuffled CS trial labels
parameters.cross_period_analysis: classifiers trained on one trial period tested on all other periods, forming a pairwise train/test accuracy matrix

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: stimulus-identity decoding accuracy over time and across trial periods

pipeline_steps.technique: Single-neuron CS-selectivity index analysis with shuffle-based significance testing

parameters.null_model: 1000 surrogate datasets with shuffled trial-type labels
parameters.grouping: computed separately for Pre- and Post-Learning trials

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: per-neuron average activity by trial type
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-neuron selectivity index and significance

pipeline_steps.technique: Neural sequence score analysis based on peak-firing-latency ordering and pairwise Spearman rank correlation across trials

parameters.correlation_metric: Spearman rank correlation of peak-latency firing order between trial pairs
parameters.null_model: 1000 surrogate datasets with per-neuron, per-trial randomized event timing
parameters.grouping: computed separately for CS+ and CS- trials

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: sequence score and significance

pipeline_steps.technique: Hidden Markov model analysis of population activity: Baum-Welch model fitting across a range of state counts, Viterbi-path state-transition-matrix similarity analysis, and CS decoding from HMM state frequencies

parameters.observation_model: independent Bernoulli process per neuron per latent state
parameters.fitting_algorithm: Baum-Welch expectation-maximization, minimum activity rate 0.001 Hz regularization
parameters.initialization: modified K-means clustering of neural data
parameters.n_states_swept: K in {5...50}, 12 random-initialization fits per K, best-likelihood model retained
parameters.grouping: separate models trained per mouse for Pre-Learning and Post-Learning trials
parameters.transition_analysis: Viterbi-decoded per-trial transition matrices (diagonal zeroed), correlated pairwise across trials, compared to a time-bin-shuffled null
parameters.cs_decoding: linear SVM trained on per-trial HMM state frequencies (0-35 s window) to decode CS identity

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: fitted HMM states/transitions and CS-decoding accuracy from state frequencies

pipeline_steps.technique: Ensemble overlap analysis between trial pairs via Jaccard similarity of active-neuron sets, z-normalized against a matched-activity-rate shuffled null

parameters.metric: Jaccard similarity index of active-neuron sets between trial pairs
parameters.null_model: 1000 surrogate scores per trial pair, randomly assigned active/inactive labels matched to observed active-neuron fraction

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: z-normalized ensemble overlap score per trial pair

papers.title: Signatures of rapid plasticity in hippocampal CA1 representations during novel experiences.

pipeline_steps.technique: Viral injection for GCaMP6f expression in dorsal CA1

parameters.coordinates: -2 mm AP; -1.5 mm ML; -1.2 mm DV relative to bregma
parameters.recovery: 3 days in home cage following viral infusion

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: mice expressing GCaMP6f in dorsal CA1 pyramidal neurons

pipeline_steps.technique: Chronic hippocampal imaging window and headpost implantation

parameters.procedure: cortex overlying left dorsal hippocampus aspirated; 3-mm glass-bottomed stainless steel cannula implanted for imaging access; titanium headpost cemented to skull
parameters.analgesia: buprenorphine or meloxicam as needed, continued 3 days postoperatively

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: mice with chronic hippocampal imaging window and headpost

pipeline_steps.technique: Head-fixed virtual-reality behavioral apparatus and position-tracking system

parameters.wheel: low-friction lightweight running wheel with an axle-coupled rotary encoder; quadrature data decoded/buffered and transmitted to an Intel NUC i5 mini-PC
parameters.control_architecture: custom PC software communicating with a custom GPIO circuit for water delivery, lick-port sensing, and imaging synchronization; all elements connected via high-speed Ethernet using UDP message passing
parameters.display: 5 LCD monitors (Acer SB230 23'' IPS) in a half-octagon covering ~220° of the visual field, each driven by an ODROID-C2 single-board computer running Android 6.0.1 to render a fraction of the VR scene

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: rendered virtual-reality environment and synchronized position/behavior signals
pipeline_steps.hardware: Intel NUC i5 mini-PC; ODROID-C2 single-board computers; Acer SB230 LCD monitors

pipeline_steps.technique: Water-restricted reward training on the VR track

parameters.habituation: starting 7 days post-surgery, handling/head-fixation habituation, then 2 days of free running before VR exposure
parameters.training_progression: rewards initially dispersed randomly, reduced over 1-2 weeks to two fixed reward zones (~1.2 m and 2.7 m on the track)
parameters.criterion: consistently running more than 130 trials using the two fixed reward zones within an hour

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: mice trained to run and lick for reward in a fixed VR track

pipeline_steps.technique: Familiar-novel context-switching paradigm

parameters.session_structure: 4 blocks per session: 40 trials Familiar, 30 trials Novel, 30 trials Familiar, 30 trials Novel
parameters.repetition: same contexts repeated across 3 days per experiment sequence; sequence repeated with a second novel context per mouse
parameters.reward_positions: fixed sucrose reward distances of 1.2 m and 2.7 m in all trials and contexts

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: imaging and behavioral data across familiar/novel context blocks

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo two-photon Ca2+ imaging acquisition

parameters.objective: 16x NIR water immersion, 0.8 NA, 3 mm WD (Nikon)
parameters.laser: 920 nm, 50-100 mW at objective back aperture (Coherent)
parameters.detection: emission filter (HQ525/70m-2p) to a GaAsP PMT (Hamamatsu 7422P-40), custom dual-stage preamp (Bruker)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: raw two-photon Ca2+ fluorescence video
pipeline_steps.hardware: Bruker 8-kHz resonant scanner; Nikon 16x NIR objective; Hamamatsu GaAsP PMT 7422P-40

pipeline_steps.technique: Motion correction and ROI detection/extraction with Suite2p

parameters.organization: imaging data organized with the SIMA software package prior to processing
parameters.roi_detection: Suite2p 'sparse mode' followed by standard fluorescence extraction and neuropil correction
parameters.curation: ROIs curated post-hoc via Suite2p's graphical interface to exclude non-somatic components

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected video with curated somatic ROI fluorescence traces

pipeline_steps.technique: Event deconvolution via OASIS

parameters.threshold: events with amplitude below 4 median absolute deviations of the raw trace discarded
parameters.output: binarized per-frame active/inactive signal, not treated as true spike times

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: binarized putative-event trains

pipeline_steps.technique: Spatial tuning curve calculation

parameters.binning: virtual track discretized into 100 evenly spaced 3-cm bins
parameters.normalization: event histogram normalized for animal occupancy
parameters.smoothing: convolved with a Gaussian kernel, σ = 9 cm

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: binarized event trains and animal position
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-neuron, per-trial spatial tuning curves

pipeline_steps.technique: Population decoding of animal position via an ensemble of support vector machines

parameters.model: ensemble of SVMs, one-vs-one multi-class decoding
parameters.training_scheme_A: trained per context block, tested on all remaining context blocks to generate position error matrices
parameters.training_scheme_B: trial-by-trial decoding accuracy assessed for the first 10 trials of each context block, trained on the remaining trials

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: decoded animal position and error matrices

pipeline_steps.technique: Population cross-correlation analysis for trial-to-trial spatial drift

parameters.method: population vector correlation between concatenated spatial tuning curves of all neurons for each trial pair, computed across a range of spatial lags
parameters.summary_metric: center-of-mass of the spatial cross-correlation curve summarizes shift direction and distance
parameters.visualization: antisymmetric shift matrix across all trial pairs; per-trial shift from averaging rows/columns of the symmetrized matrix
parameters.exclusion: trial pairs with peak cross-correlation below 0.1 excluded; experiments with more than one-third of pairs excluded were omitted

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: per-trial spatial tuning curves for a neural population
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: trial-pair spatial shift matrix and per-trial shift estimates

pipeline_steps.technique: Simulation of place-field accumulation dynamics for validating the drift analysis

parameters.population: 300 simulated neurons, 0.2 probability of acquiring a place field, fields accumulated over 30 trials via a geometric process with mean 6
parameters.field_model: Gaussian bump activity (σ = 5 bins) at uniformly sampled field centers
parameters.btsp_condition: fixed BTSP probability per simulation; BTSP fields shifted 0-0.25x environment length on the first trial with gain sampled 1-3x
parameters.drift_condition: fixed drifting probability per simulation; drift slope sampled 0-3 cm/trial
parameters.noise: out-of-field Gaussian noise bumps (probability 0.2) and per-trial multiplicative gain noise ~N(1, 0.05)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: simulated place-field datasets for validating the cross-correlation drift metric

pipeline_steps.technique: Place-field detection via shuffled null distribution

parameters.null_construction: each trial's activity circularly shifted by an independent random distance, smoothed trial-averaged tuning curve recomputed; repeated 1,000 times per neuron
parameters.threshold: 95th percentile of null tuning values at each spatial bin (p < 0.05)
parameters.field_criteria: candidate fields = contiguous segments exceeding the null threshold; width restricted to less than 1 m (one-third of the track); required activity within field bounds on at least 15 trials

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: detected place fields with significance-tested boundaries

pipeline_steps.technique: Ensemble overlap (Jaccard similarity) analysis across context blocks

parameters.vector: binary per-neuron vector of significant place-field presence per context block
parameters.metric: Jaccard similarity between each pair of context blocks
parameters.normalization: z-scored against a shuffle distribution from 10,000 random permutations of each block's place-cell vector

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: normalized ensemble overlap scores between context blocks

pipeline_steps.technique: Normalized spatial tuning score via KL-divergence

parameters.raw_score: KL-divergence between the normalized spatial tuning curve (treated as a pseudo-probability mass function) and the uniform distribution
parameters.normalization: standardized relative to a null distribution of tuning scores computed on the null tuning curves generated for place-field detection

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: spatial tuning curves and their null-shuffle counterparts
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: normalized per-neuron spatial tuning scores

pipeline_steps.technique: Place-field formation characterization

parameters.formation_trial: first trial within the first 5-trial window where the neuron was active in the field on at least 3 trials (following Sheffield et al., 2017); active = amplitude at least 5% of peak activity
parameters.activity_displacement: spatial shift between peak firing location on the formation trial and peak of the average tuning of all subsequent trials
parameters.formation_gain: peak activity rate on the formation trial divided by peak activity rate in the average tuning of subsequent active trials
parameters.perifield_velocity: average animal velocity within the place-field boundaries during the formation trial

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: detected place fields and per-trial activity
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: formation trial, activity displacement, gain, and perifield velocity per place field

pipeline_steps.technique: Velocity-field width correlation with permutation testing

parameters.model: linear model predicting place-field width from perifield formation velocity, fit per trial block per day
parameters.comparison: slope difference (Novel minus Familiar) computed per context switch
parameters.significance: 10,000 shuffles of context labels per condition; p-value from the Gaussian CDF fit to the null slope-difference distribution, reported as -log10(p)

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: per-field width and perifield formation velocity
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: context-dependent velocity-width slope estimates and significance

pipeline_steps.technique: LNP network model of BTSP-mediated place-field formation

parameters.architecture: linear-nonlinear-Poisson (LNP) cascade model of a CA1 neuron receiving input from 300 simulated CA3 place cells (Gaussian tuning, width σ=10 cm, max rate 30 Hz, evenly distributed field centers)
parameters.output_nonlinearity: CA1 instantaneous firing rate as an exponential function of summed weighted CA3 input, scaled to a 30 Hz maximum
parameters.trial_structure: 16 simulated trials (1 pre-plasticity, 15 post-plasticity), 1-ms timesteps, 2-s inter-trial interval, constant velocity per simulation
parameters.spike_to_fluorescence: 200 unique Poisson spike trains per condition convolved with an idealized calcium kernel (τ_decay=0.7 s, τ_rise=0.07 s), subsampled to 10 Hz, corrupted with additive Gaussian noise at SNR in {0.5,1,2,4,8,16}, then passed through the same deconvolution workflow used on real data
parameters.btsp_plasticity_rule: asymmetric double-exponential plasticity kernel (Bittner et al., 2017) applied to CA3-CA1 weights at a fixed plateau-onset location (200 cm)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: simulated CA1 spike trains, fluorescence traces, and inferred activity shifts

pipeline_steps.technique: NMF decomposition and K-means clustering of place-field trial-dynamics patterns

parameters.feature_construction: 150-cm (50-bin) activity window around each place field's center, concatenated across the first 10 trials from the formation trial, yielding a 500-element vector per field
parameters.decomposition: non-negative matrix factorization minimizing the Frobenius norm of X - WH, with n=11 components chosen at the loss-curve elbow
parameters.clustering: K-means clustering (K=2) on the 11 NMF weight patterns to partition fields into 'BTSP-like' and 'other' groups

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: NMF component weights and BTSP-like/other cluster assignments

pipeline_steps.technique: SVM-based decoding validation of BTSP vs. Other place-field classification

parameters.features: 4 features per place field: first-to-later-trial tuning shift, field width, stability (even/odd trial correlation), first-trial activity gain
parameters.validation: 10 stratified 50/50 train/test splits per mouse with inverse-frequency sample weighting; null distribution from 1,000 permutations of BTSP labels, significance from the 95% interval of the null accuracy distribution

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: secondary place-field activity features and NMF/K-means cluster labels
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: cross-validated decoding accuracy for BTSP vs. Other classification

pipeline_steps.technique: Linear model of place-field density as a function of velocity history

parameters.predictors: exponentially filtered spatial velocity profile at multiple time constants (τ in {0.01, 0.025, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25} spatial bins) to capture short-term history effects

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: spatial velocity profile and place-field density
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: fitted velocity filters predicting place-field density

pipeline_steps.technique: Next-trial place-field distance analysis

parameters.metric: average distance from each place field to fields forming on the immediately following trial, computed only between fields of the same BTSP classification
parameters.null_model: distances standardized against a null formed by randomly permuting place-field formation-trial assignments within each BTSP classification and trial block; repeated 200 times per field

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: place-field formation trials and BTSP classifications
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: standardized next-trial field-distance measure

behaviorMate: An Intranet of Things Approach for Adaptable Control of Behavioral and Navigation-Based Experiments.

pipeline_steps.technique: VRMate virtual-reality rendering system: Unity/C# application running on one ODROID C4 single-board computer per display, receiving UDP position updates from the behaviorMate UI and rendering the virtual environment independently per display for scalability

parameters.sbc: ODROID C4 (Amlogic S905X3 Quad-Core Cortex-A55, 4 GiB RAM, Mali-G31 MP2 GPU), one per display, Android OS
parameters.protocol: UDP packets carrying position updates from behaviorMate UI
parameters.scalability: independent per-display rendering avoids frame-rate/resolution loss when adding displays

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: rendered VR scene synchronized to animal virtual position

pipeline_steps.technique: Imaging-compatible custom Unity shader programs suppressing green/red color channels in rendered VR scenes to minimize fluorescence-imaging artifacts

parameters.mechanism: custom shader programs editing per-pixel color values prior to rendering, enabled via the behaviorMate UI
parameters.use_case: zeroing the green or red pixel component to reduce artifacts during GFP/RFP-based calcium imaging

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: imaging-artifact-minimized VR display output
